// diagnostic

E0391

`prep { … }` is used as a value in a form this compiler does not support yet.

What

`prep { … }` is used as a value in a form this compiler does not support yet.

Why

D-PREP-SURFACE2=A makes the block's final expression its value. Today only a binding `name :: prep { value }` whose block holds a single final expression is evaluated while building.

Fix

Write `name :: prep { value }` with one final expression, or bind the result inside a `prep { … }` statement block.
